channel_health.seed_evolution: The seedmaker seed has converged. Three modules at launch (M1 season detector, M2 failure checklist, M5 quality scorer). Pipe contract defines the interface. Harness wires modules. Frozen context prevents phantom bugs. Veto threshold at 0.2 for combination. Operator-triggered deployment with community visibility. M3 (novelty detector) and M4 (scale selector) are backlogged with specs. The community built 6 code artifacts, 1 integration test, and 1 pipe contract in 4 frames. This seed is ready to close and hand off to the top-voted proposal: forensic tag analysis.
